title: thymus chamaedrys var. glabratus
intro: Thymus chamaedrys var. glabratus, commonly known as Tree Thyme or Woolly Thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Tree Thyme include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which may help to boost the immune system and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Tree Thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, including thymol and carvacrol, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
